model: seed · pre-authored example (used when live AI is off or unavailable)

clientObjectives.text: You want to diversify beyond listed markets and invest in the real economy.
Your investment horizon is 15 years or longer.

riskProfile.text: Your risk profile is risk class 6. This matches the product risk indicator of the fund, SRI 6.
You understand that returns are not guaranteed.

knowledgeAndExperience.text: You have invested directly in startups as an angel investor, with one exit in 2019.
You have not yet invested in a private equity fund.

financialSituationAndLossCapacity.text: You hold €900,000 with us and told us your investable wealth is €3,000,000, including bank deposits of €1,400,000.
After this investment, private markets would make up 6.7% of your investable wealth.
You confirmed that you could bear a total loss of the committed amount without changing your plans.

whyTheProductFits.text: Meridian Buyout V matches your wish to invest in private companies and your long horizon.
A commitment of €200,000 meets the fund minimum. You can leave the money invested for the fund term of 10 years.

risksExplained.text: Your money is locked for about ten years, and capital calls come over three to four years.
The fund is likely to show a loss in its first years (the J-curve).
Distributions are not guaranteed. You could lose part or all of the committed amount.
We explained the costs; see the cost disclosure.

alternativesConsidered.text: We discussed an ELTIF with a lower minimum and no capital calls. You prefer the buyout fund.

clientMessage.subject: Summary of our conversation on private markets
clientMessage.body: Dear Claudia, thank you for our conversation. In the app you will find the suitability statement and the cost disclosure for Meridian Buyout V. Please read both before you sign. Your commitment would be €200,000, with a first capital call of €40,000 at first close. If anything is unclear, just reply here. Best, Jonas
